highlights.reason_zh: 三篇撤稿说明模型生成的数学成果必须把形式化覆盖和依赖复核设为发布闸门。
highlights.reason_en: Three withdrawals show that model-generated mathematics needs formal coverage and dependency review as release gates.

highlights.reason_zh: Docker Agent 把多 agent、MCP、评估和 OCI 分发合进可运行的开源工具。
highlights.reason_en: Docker Agent combines multi-agent workflows, MCP, evaluation and OCI distribution in a runnable open-source tool.

highlights.reason_zh: SciExam 用隐藏科学测试评估未知答案任务，比 rubric 匹配更接近真实科研验收。
highlights.reason_en: SciExam uses hidden scientific tests for unknown-answer tasks, moving beyond rubric matching toward real research validation.

highlights.reason_zh: ExpDis 把探索策略与生产 student 分开，公开代码足以做小规模复测。
highlights.reason_en: ExpDis separates exploration from the production student and publishes enough artifacts for a small replication.

highlights.reason_zh: Claude Code 修复自然语言 hook 的错误放行，直接影响把 hook 当策略闸门的团队。
highlights.reason_en: Claude Code fixes fail-open natural-language hooks, directly affecting teams that use hooks as policy gates.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部抓取并读完；本轮新增 6 条事件，更新 3 条既有事件，并完成 AstaBrief-8B 七日复核。召回自检匹配 16 条、此前已处置 6 条，并新增处置 4 条。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and read. The run added six events, updated three existing events and completed the seven-day AstaBrief-8B review. Recall audit matched 16 signals, recognized six previously handled signals and dispositioned four new items.
